name: coordinator-mode
description: Coordinate complex engineering work through bounded delegation, single-writer ownership, active supervision, and evidence-backed integration.

interface.longDescription: Coordinate genuinely complex engineering work as a small set of bounded lanes with explicit authority, single-writer ownership, active drift control, truthful partial-result handling, and direct verification before integration.
defaultPrompt: Coordinate this complex engineering task with bounded agents.
Delegate independent implementation lanes and verify the result.
Supervise a parallel read-only audit and synthesize the evidence.
